# Tasks Document Tasks are ordered so dependencies flow naturally: dependencies → build-time helpers → Velite shared plugin stack → posts collection (split into atomic schema/rejection/reading-time/bodyHtml subtasks) → siteConfig audit → fixtures → query layer → presentation → routes → syndication → verification scaffolding → tests → final integration smoke. Each task references the design section that pins its behavior and the requirements it satisfies. ## Revision history - **v2 (post-r1 adversarial review)**: Carve out `` comment-shaped html nodes in the rejection visitor (Task 4.2) so fixture FIXTURE-NOTE markers do not crash Velite. Split Task 4 into 4.1–4.4 with the `]]>` substitution promoted to a body bullet. Pin literal Shiki target-variable names (`--shiki-light`/`--shiki-dark`) in globals.css — no deferral, no forward dependency. Replace dashboard `` launch gate with dual assertions: parsed-tree (via `cdataPropName`) AND raw-string CDATA framing. Relocate build-time helpers to `src/lib/build/*.ts` so Vitest's default resolution sees them. Add Task 5 (siteConfig audit/extension for RSS channel-metadata fields). Commit a fixture image asset in Task 6. Pin `BLOG_INCLUDE_DRAFTS` at step level only in Task 20, and pin the e2e server-boot env-propagation contract. Pin `node-html-parser` as the HTML parser for the body-parity test in Task 27 (was three undecided options). Acknowledge that the sentinel check is defense-in-depth (catches the `rm -rf` regression class), not topology proof. - **v3 (post-r2 adversarial review)**: Add explicit `Depends on:` ordering footers between sibling tasks that have a real ordering edge (Task 6 depends on 4.1, etc.). Pin literal alt text in fixtures (Task 6). Expand Task 4.2 success to include a multi-line FIXTURE-NOTE comment test. Add Task 6.5 — `src/lib/blog-errors.ts` exporting shared error-message constants imported by both `getPublishedPosts()` (Task 7) and `next.config.ts` (Task 16) so the operator-facing runbook lives in one place. Add Vercel-log manual-verification step to Task 16's success criterion (closes the same staleness pattern as design-r3). Move Task 20's `touch sentinel` to immediately after `pnpm build` succeeds (so the sentinel signals "Build 1 reached cleanup" rather than "Build 1 completed every step"); drop the e2e step's "defense-in-depth" framing for the env var and reframe as "forward-compat pin." Add Task 20.5 — `scripts/verify-ci-topology.mjs` (YAML-parses ci.yml and asserts the structural pins r1/r2 surfaced — mechanical defense, parallel to Task 17's ESLint chokepoint). Acknowledge Task 9's pinned variable names ARE structurally verified at Task 28, and pin Task 28 to re-run Tasks 24 + 26 if its spot-check patches globals.css (cite re-run output in the implementation log). Add Task 22.5 — synthetic-input unit test for `countWordsFromMdast` so a walker bug isn't hidden by the identity assertion's same-function-both-sides tautology; pin Task 22's reading-time substrate as `post.body` from `#site/content`. Clarify `_Requirements:` footer semantics ("this task contributes to satisfying these requirements"). Add the Requirements Coverage Matrix at the document foot — orphan requirements become visible. - **v4 (post-r3 adversarial review, FINAL)**: Promote `checkVercelDraftGuard()` from "optional helper" to required export in Task 6.5; add env-var-name string constants (`VERCEL_ENV_VAR_NAME`, `VERCEL_FLAG_VAR_NAME`, `DRAFT_FLAG_VAR_NAME`) so literal env-var names live once. Disambiguate `code` (block) vs. `inlineCode` (span) in Task 2's walker contract — drop both. Pin Task 22.5's mdast construction substrate to `unist-builder` and pin three separate test cases. Add new Task 6.6 — direct truth-table test for `checkVercelDraftGuard()` in `src/lib/blog-errors.test.ts`. Pin literal `name:` strings for each CI step in Task 20; extend Task 20.5 pin (a) to cover workflow-level env (not just job-level); pin verifier "missing step = fatal exit" semantics; add sibling self-test fixtures for the verifier. Drop Task 28's "only on patch" gate — Tasks 24 + 26 re-run unconditionally as part of the spot-check AND the implementation log captures computed hex values compared against expected github-light/github-dark theme hexes. Pin Playwright report citation format (JSON `results` array fragment). Add new Task 28.5 — `scripts/verify-requirements-coverage.mjs` AND `scripts/verify-task-dependencies.mjs` (mechanical defenses for matrix + dependency graph). Add Vitest `include` pattern verification to Task 22.5. Extend `Depends on:` footers to every remaining task so the graph is complete. Pin Task 21's threshold contract (≥90 across performance/a11y/best-practices/SEO). --- ## `_Requirements:` footer semantics Each task carries a `_Requirements:` footer listing requirement IDs from `requirements.md`. The semantics are **"this task contributes to satisfying these requirements"** (in whole or in part) — *not* "this task transitively depends on these requirements."
